tasks.label: Karta: MySQL (portable install)
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $base=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'mysql-8.4\mysql-8.4.9-winx64'; $exe=Join-Path $base 'bin\mysqld.exe'; if(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3306 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){Write-Output 'MySQL is already listening on port 3306'; exit 0}; if(!(Test-Path $exe)){Write-Error 'Portable MySQL was not found under LOCALAPPDATA; start your configured MySQL Windows service or edit this VS Code task.'; exit 1}; & $exe "--basedir=$base" "--datadir=$base\data" '--port=3306' '--bind-address=127.0.0.1' '--console'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
